CRAFTWARE HOMEPAGE — DIRECTION B (OBJECT FIRST)
Dark, cinematic, centred. Space Grotesk + Geist. Violet / blue / cyan on near-black. The glass 'C' is the recurring signature object.
Motion to be built in code (Lenis smooth scroll + GSAP ScrollTrigger + React Three Fiber):
• Hero — glass 'C' reacts to mouse; particles drift; headline mask-reveals line by line.
• Services — hovering a row expands its type, blooms a radial glow, floats keyword tags, shows a cursor label.
• Work — vertical scroll drives the rail horizontally; centre panel scales up; cursor reads VIEW PROJECT.
• Process — the gradient line draws left-to-right as the section scrolls into view; node 03 is the live step.
• Case Study — modal-morph in from the Work panel; metrics count up on enter.
• Final CTA — sibling 3D object drifts behind the text; magnetic buttons; footer underlines animate.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference only.
A) Kinetic Type — headline as the whole composition.
C) Editorial Split — chapter marker + spec sheet + bordered object panel.
Direction B won; the Homepage System page is the live design.
